description.text: Project IntroductionThis major is taught in English, aiming to cultivate applied, compound, innovative and entrepreneurial management talents who can systematically master modern economic management theories and methods, possess an international perspective, innovative consciousness, teamwork spirit and communication skills, and be capable of engaging in economic management work.The basic duration of study for this major is 4 years, with a flexible system ranging from 4 to 6 years. Students who meet the graduation requirements will be awarded a Bachelor of Management degree.

duration.text: The Business Administration at Zhejiang Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Registration photo: 2-inch recent colored photo;2. Copy of passport: provide the personal information page and the passport should remain valid at least one year after your registration3. Copy of visa: applicants in China must provide;4. Copy of your notarized high school diploma:Prospective students must submit official proof of student status by their current school. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. Please take the original copy of your current highest diploma with you for registration.5. Copy of your high school academic transcripts (Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations.) or UEC/A Level/ AP/IB/ SAT/ACT result；6. Language proficiency certificate: Applicant who applies for Chinese taught programs should submit HSK 4 or higher certificate, applicants who apply for English taught programs should submit TOEFL result with a score above 80 or IELTS result with a score above 5.5;7. Foreigner physical examination form: bearing the stamp of the hospital. Physical examination results are valid for 6 months. （ complete it in Chinese or English, The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Please select the appropriate time to take a physical examination as the result is valid for only 6 months.)8. Police Certificate;9. A statement of no drug addiction history;10. Bank Statement: to prove that the applicant has sufficient funds to cover his or her tuition, accommodation, living expenses, and international travels during his or her study in China. The only applicant himself/herself or his/her family can act as a financial sponsor.11. Study plan:(1). no less than 1000 words, applicants who apply for an English taught program should write the plan in English, applicants who apply for a Chinese taught program should write in Chines.(2). If applicants apply for more than 2 programs, the applicant should submit study plans for each program.12. Transfer letter: applicants who are already studying in other universities in China should submit13. Other supporting documents: paper published, volunteering certificates, etc. if any

requirements.text: 1. Applicant should be aged between 18 and 30 (born after September 1, 1992);2. Applicant should be non-Chinese citizens with a valid regular foreign passport;*Residents of Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan who have emigrated to a foreign country and who are now applying to study in China as international students must have held a valid foreign passport for at least 4 years, and must have actually resided in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the past 4 years (as of April 30, 2022). (9 months of residence in a foreign country may count as a full year. The dates of the entry and exit stamps in the passport will be followed in the determination of the actual length of foreign residence).3. Applicant should hold a high school diploma with a satisfactory academic record;4. Language requirement: an applicant who applies for Chinese taught programs should have HSK 4 certificate or above, applicants who apply for English taught programs should have a TOEFL score above 80 (TOEFL MyBest scores are accepted, DI CODE: C824 ) or IELTS score above 5.5;5. Applicant should have no criminal record and no drug addiction history;6. Applicants should be in good health and have no serious infectious diseases.
